description: Defines the CompilationResult class in the SCSSPHP library, representing the result of compiling SCSS to CSS, including CSS output, source map, and included files.

classes.name: CompilationResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the output of an SCSS compilation, including CSS, optional source map, and included files.

methods.name: getSourceMap
methods.description: Returns the source map string if generated, otherwise null.

methods.name: getIncludedFiles
methods.description: Returns an array of file paths that were included during compilation.
